name: project.create
description: Create a project, or return the existing project for a folder when projectRoot is supplied. Projects group chat sessions under a title and an optional filesystem root.

projectRoot.description: Absolute folder that owns the project; reusing an existing folder reuses its project

nodeId.description: Node that owns the folder; defaults to the local gateway

instructions.description: Optional instructions shown to agents inside the project

name: project.list
description: List active projects owned by the caller, newest activity first, with their root folder and node.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter over title, root folder and description

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (1-100, default 20)

name: project.assign_repository
description: Attach a git repository to a project so agents can address it by repository id.

name: project.move
description: Move a project under a different parent project, or to the project root when parentId is null.

parentId.description: New parent project id, or null for the top level

title.description: Optional new title applied after the move

name: project.transfer
description: Move a project to a different node and folder. Any repository attachment is cleared because repository ids are node scoped.

targetRootPath.description: Absolute folder on the destination node
